summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of ProjectHub. 14/14 pytest backend tests passed covering auth, dashboard, projects CRUD, tasks/kanban lifecycle, team CRUD, comments, files (upload/download via Bearer & ?auth=), notifications, settings + slack (fake URL returns 400 not 500), and reports. Frontend UI tested end-to-end: pre-filled login works, dashboard renders all KPIs/recent projects/deadlines/activity, all sidebar links + KPI + header data-testids present, projects list shows seeded + newly created project, project detail shows all 5 kanban columns + all tabs + kanban-new-task-button, files/reports/notifications pages load, mark-all-read works, settings save works, test-slack correctly shows error toast for fake webhook URL (400 from backend).
action_items: MINOR (spec mismatch, not a bug): Review request referenced data-testid 'add-member-button' on Team page, but implementation uses 'team-add-button'. Functionality works. Consider aligning naming or updating spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~830 lines - acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers (auth/projects/tasks/files/etc.) if it grows.
Object storage init requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; upload endpoint returns 503 if missing. Works in this env.
slack_notify swallows all exceptions; good for resilience but ensure logging is monitored.
seed_admin updates password when changed - idempotent behavior confirmed.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 projects, 4 team members, 13 tasks on first startup. Verified present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend fully functional. Only minor discrepancy: Team page 'Add member' button uses data-testid='team-add-button', not 'add-member-button' as referenced in review request. All other referenced data-testids (sidebar-link-*, stat-card-*, header-search-input, quick-add-*, new-project-button, kanban-column-*, kanban-new-task-button, tabs, mark-all-read-button, etc.) are present and working. Slack test with fake URL correctly returns 400 and shows error toast.
